name: shuut
description: Make and edit images, videos and audio with shuut from your agent: step-by-step skills plus the shuut MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Image generation, video generation and image/video editing with GPT Image, Nano Banana, Seedream image generation, Seedance video generation, Kling and Veo: product shots, ads and avatars. Also voice, music and captions. Billed to your shuut credits. 1 credit = 1 US cent, same prices as the shuut app. Pass `dry_run: true` first to any paid tool for the exact price without spending; `max_spend_credits` caps a call.
defaultPrompt: Show me my shuut credit balance.
Make a 9:16 product photo of my sneaker on wet asphalt at night.
Turn this image into a 5-second video.
